map.调整光圈、快门速度与 ISO 三者之一，工具联动计算保持等量曝光所需的另两项参数: Adjust one of aperture, shutter speed and ISO; the tool computes the changes in the other two needed to keep equal exposure, demonstrating the seesaw relation of the exposure triangle, helping photographers control depth of field and motion blur without changing brightness.
map.逆光人像想用大光圈虚化背景时，需在曝光三角形中提高快门速度或降低 ISO，避免画: For backlit portraits wanting large aperture to blur the background, raise shutter speed or lower ISO in the exposure triangle to avoid overexposure.
map.弱光手持拍摄为压低快门防抖，往往开大光圈或提升 ISO，但需权衡景深变浅与噪点增: In low light handheld shooting to lower shutter for stabilization, often open aperture or raise ISO, but must balance shallower depth of field and more noise.
map.拍摄运动物体需高速快门定格瞬间，可用开大光圈或提高 ISO 补偿进光量，维持曝光: Shooting moving objects needs high shutter speed to freeze the moment; use open aperture or raised ISO to compensate light intake and keep exposure unchanged.
map.：以 f/5.6、1/60s、ISO100 为例：EV100=log₂(5.6²: : using f/5.6, 1/60s, ISO100 as example: EV100=log2(5.6^2 / 0.0167) approx 10.9, ISO adjustment 0 stops, actual EV approx 10.9, corresponding to "sunny outdoor" scenario; changing any vertex (aperture/shutter/ISO) by one stop requires reverse-compensating the other two to keep equal exposure.
map.EV 值代表什么含义？: What does the EV value mean?
map.EV（曝光值）量化进光量，数值每加 1 表示进光量翻倍、减 1 表示减半；它是光: EV (exposure value) quantifies light intake; each +1 doubles the light, -1 halves it; it is the combined result of aperture, shutter, and ISO.
map.为什么改一档光圈要补偿其他参数？: Why compensate other parameters when changing one aperture stop?
map.三角形任一顶点改变都会改变总进光量，保持等量曝光须由另两个顶点反向补偿相同档数，: Changing any vertex of the triangle changes total light intake; to keep equal exposure the other two vertices must compensate the same number of stops in reverse, so brightness stays unchanged.

Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.选择光圈、快门速度与 ISO 计算 EV 与实际曝光值；点击“等量曝光组合”固定: Choose aperture, shutter speed and ISO to calculate EV and exposure; the equal-exposure button fixes ISO and lists ±2-stop standard aperture/shutter combinations with EV and deviation, marking targets outside the built-in ranges as unavailable. Changing one field does not auto-link the others—click the button.

Starting at f/22, 1s, +2 stops would need f/31.1 at 4s, outside the built-in f/1.4–f/22 and 1/1000s–1s ranges; the table marks it unavailable instead of passing off the endpoint as the target.
map.EV=log₂(N²/t) 只由光圈与快门定义，EV 加 1 表示该光圈/快门组: EV = log₂(N²/t) is defined only by aperture and shutter; +1 EV means one stop less light in that aperture/shutter combination (half the optical exposure). ISO only changes brightness gain, not the optical light entering the lens.
map.改动一个参数会自动联动吗？: Does changing one parameter auto-link the others?

The built-in ranges cover only f/1.4–f/22 and 1/1000s–1s; outside them the row says unavailable.
